instruction.text: Choose the correct helping verb to fill in the gap.

atoms.b: I ((++was were)) walking to school when I saw her.
They ((was ++were)) waiting for their mum to pick them up.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the past progressive form of the verb.

hint.text:
The past progressive is formed with the helping verbs was/were and a main verb that has the ending -ing.
For example: “I was walking home.”
“You were walking home.”
hint.sound: ssml: The past progressive is formed with the helping verbs was or were, and a main verb that has the ending 'i n g.'. For example: I was walking home. You were walking home.

atoms.b: Sean ((was_taking)) my suitcase inside for me.
They ((were_breaking)) in their new skates yesterday.
Flo ((was_watching)) an exciting new film with her brother.
My friends ((were_colouring)) in the picture they drew together.
We ((were_asking)) the teacher if we could sit next to each other.
